mentions.name: Starkeep
mentions.description: Open-source serverless self-hosting platform that lets users keep their own data and build apps that run on their own devices and AWS account. Provides a common core with file indexing, syncing, and access control, making apps easy to create and interoperable, with a serverless architecture that minimizes running costs. MIT licensed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Starkeep, an open-source serverless self-hosting system that lets you keep your own data and build your own apps that run on your devices and your own AWS account.
